runtime.name: codex-cli
runtime.configuration: Persisted sessions in a disposable isolated Codex state directory with user config and rules ignored; generated Skill linked under project .agents/skills.
runtime.permissionProfile: read-only sandbox with approval policy never

assertions.evidence: The parent read the generated check-parallel Skill before executing it.
The persisted parent transcript recorded two spawn_agent calls and a world state with both children running before the first wait completed.
Two child transcripts completed and sent separately attributable FINAL_ANSWER messages to the parent before its final root read.
The left child transcript alone read assets/left.txt and reported LEFT_MARKER=parallel-ok.
The right child transcript alone read assets/right.txt and reported RIGHT_MARKER=parallel-ok.
The parent read only assets/root.txt before spawning and independently again after both child results.
All threads inherited the read-only sandbox and the external post-run Git status was clean.

limitations: The top-level --json stream omits spawn detail, so the persisted isolated parent and child transcripts are the authoritative lifecycle evidence.
This fixture proves parallel read-only fan-out and wait-all, not follow-up, cancellation, transcript API access, or writer isolation.
This evidence applies to Codex CLI only; desktop and IDE profiles remain unknown.
